facts.business: Hindustan Composites Limited manufactures composite products including railway brake blocks and friction materials for automotive and railway sectors, and also engages in investments and trading in metals and commodities.

auditor.name: Lodha & Co. LLP

Volatility in steel, aluminum, copper, and other commodity prices
Changes in regulatory and emission norms
Intensifying competition from domestic and international players
